node.statement: Dagger step. If A is in S_{P_n}, then A=Co_{P_n}(A); lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives A^dagger=Co_{P_n}(A^dagger), so the inherited isometric dagger preserves the corner. For A,B in the corner, that external and ambient anti-multiplicativity give (A dot B)^dagger=Co_{P_n}((AB)^dagger)=Co_{P_n}(B^dagger A^dagger)=B^dagger dot A^dagger. Also P_n^dagger=P_n by def-delta-projection, hence u_{P,n}^dagger=Co_{P_n}(P_n)^dagger=Co_{P_n}(P_n^dagger)=u_{P,n}.
